# Acme Storefront

A static shop site: six pages in `site/`, styles in `site/css/`, scripts in `site/js/`.

- `npm start` serves the site on http://127.0.0.1:$PORT (the `PORT` variable is set).
- `npx playwright test tests/functional.spec.ts` runs the functional tests.
- `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts` compares each page, at desktop and phone size, with approved screenshots; the differences are saved as images in `test-results/`.

Dependencies are installed. There is no network access.

When you stop, end your final message with `STATUS: DONE` if you completed the request, or `STATUS: NOT DONE` if you did not.

content.text:
The products page is fixed. The "New" and "Sale" badges on the product cards were being cut off at the card edge, and they now display in full.

The cause was `overflow: hidden` on `.card` in `site/css/components.css`. The badges are positioned 10px outside the card's corner, so the card was clipping them. I removed that one line. The card thumbnail already has its own rounded top corners, so the cards look the same otherwise.

All 28 tests pass, including the desktop and phone screenshot comparisons for the products page that were failing before.

STATUS: DONE
